subject: Offline activation checkpoint and signer audit rehearsal
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Moore <dmoore@acme-corp.com>, FastShip Logistics <ops@fastship.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offline activation checkpoint and signer audit rehearsal

Hi Danielle / FastShip ops,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the physical handoff rehearsal for the air-gapped activation next week. To make sure the dry-run is useful for both teams, we want to validate three things in one 90–120 minute session:

1) Courier staging and handoff timing (simulate arrival, custody transfer, proof-of-delivery)
2) Signed-manifest verification and operator acceptance (manifest parsing, signature chain validation)
3) Emergency rollback / revocation exercise (simulate manifest revocation and swap-in)

Attached is the manifest-schema_v2.json model we will use for the rehearsal, plus a short example of the signed-manifest format we expect. Please confirm:
- You can run a simulated courier delivery on Thu 2028-06-28 between 09:00–11:30 PT.
- FastShip will include a tamper-evident seal ID printed on the manifest and on the physical seal.
- Acme expects us to validate signatures using the offline public key bundle (we will provide the bundle at the start of the simulation).

Operational asks from Redwood:
- One operator (on-site or onsite-proxy) who will perform the acceptance steps.
- A single contact at FastShip for chain-of-custody confirmations (name & mobile).

I will coordinate the Redwood participants and run the signing/verification steps. If that window doesn't work, propose two alternatives.

Thanks,
Irene
--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
[attachment: manifest-schema_v2.json (application/json)]
From: Danielle Moore <dmoore@acme-corp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: FastShip Logistics <ops@fastship.co>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:05:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offline activation checkpoint and signer audit rehearsal

Irene —

Thanks for the clear plan. Thu 06/28 09:00–11:30 PT works for Acme's ops and for our security team to observe. A few quick notes:

- FastShip can run the courier sim during that window; ops@fastship.co (cc'd) is our logistics lead. Please treat that as the operational contact.
- We'll need the manifest-schema_v2.json and an example signed-manifest at least 48 hours before the dry-run so our acceptance automation can pre-load parsing rules.
- For the revocation exercise: Acme requires we exercise both an immediate revocation (manifest replaced at handoff) and a delayed revocation (operator rejects after physical inspection).

If Redwood can drop a preflight checklist and the public key bundle by EOD Tue 06/26, we'll be set.

On Thu we'll have a small security observer and our plant on-site ops engineer. Link me to the verification script you plan to run.

—Danielle
Danielle Moore
Program Manager, Platform Security — Acme Corp
[dmoore@acme-corp.com]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offline activation checkpoint and signer audit rehearsal

Irene / team —

Thanks — I took Danielle's notes and drafted a rehearsal runbook. Summary (attached as preflight-checklist.pdf and courier-sim-script.txt):

Runbook highlights:
- 08:45: Redwood operator check-in (SSH disabled, KVM access to host ready).
- 09:00: FastShip simulated arrival, exchange of sealed manifest (paper + USDL QR).
- 09:10: Operator scans manifest, performs checksum and signature verification using offline public key bundle.
- 09:25: If signature verifies, operator initiates artifact import (operator keys & HSM stub).
- 09:45: Activation window: install image, run smoke tests, report status.
- 10:15: Revocation test A: present replaced manifest with revoked signature; operator must refuse and trigger contingency.
- 10:40: Revocation test B: operator accepts then later detects mismatch; exercise rollback procedure to previous image and log chain-of-custody.

Operational notes:
- Bring two copies of the signed-manifest: original and 'tampered' (for the revocation exercise).
- We will use an offline verification tool that returns a three-state result: VALID / INVALID / UNVERIFIABLE. The tool will log decisions and operator acknowledgement.
- Ben: please prepare the offline public key bundle and a short README on validation steps. Attachments I added: preflight-checklist.pdf and courier-sim-script.txt.

Irene: I'll schedule the calendar invite and include a 15-minute post-mortem slot.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offline activation checkpoint and signer audit rehearsal

Quick confirmation —

All set for Thu 06/28 09:00–11:30 PT. A couple of additional points from the infra side:

- Fallback policy: if checksum/signature validation fails, operator MUST not proceed. The fallback is to: 1) quarantine the package, 2) call Acme security and Redwood SRE, 3) use a pre-approved rollback image from the sealed image store.
- Key handling: Ben, please ensure the public key bundle is accompanied by a key-rotation timestamp and that we sign the verification artifact with the current operator key.
- Evidence capture: operator should capture photos of the seal, scanned manifest, and a short log export. We'll store those artifacts in a secure bucket and link them to the activation record (post-run).

Ben — can you drop signed-manifest_v2.json and the key bundle into the shared Drive folder by EOD Tue so Acme can pre-load rules? I've added the DocuSign envelope for the acceptance form if Acme needs an exec signoff (link in metadata).

If there are no objections I'll send the final calendar invite and include dial-in details for Acme security.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
